description: The lexical hard cases gate G1b names (docs/architecture/qdrant-retrieval-design.md §10): § references, dotted Punkt numbers, ALLCAPS codes, closed compounds and umlaut/ß spelling variants. Each case is a query plus an ORACLE: a case-insensitive Python regex over the chunk text (and an optional exclude regex). A chunk is relevant when the oracle matches and the exclude does not. The oracle is a statement about the TEXT, not about any ranking, so it cannot drift with the channel it scores. Counts in notes were measured on the 2023 corpus with production's exclude_file_names applied.

cases.notes: 24 chunks. A whitespace tokenizer keeps only the digit 8, which is on hundreds of chunks.
